verdicts.reason: S1 (Bloomberg) says DBS is adding bullion storage capacity 'and other banks considering similar moves.'
S1 says DBS 'increased its vaulting space this year' and describes this as bullion storage capacity, so the gold vaulting framing is accurate.
S1 says OCBC 'has also approached precious metal storage providers about securing more space,' according to people with knowledge of the matter.
